sources.title:
10K views · 188 reactions | France officially owned Louisiana for just twenty days, and New Orleans was where it happened.

On November 30, 1803, Spain formally transferred Louisiana to France in a ceremony at the Cabildo. On December 20, 1803, the territory was officially transferred from France to the United States, and the U.S. took possession ten days later.

Have you ever toured the Cabildo in the French Quarter, and which part of its history surprised you most?

Trivia: The U.S. Senate ratified the Louisiana Purchase treaty on October 20, 1803, by a vote of 24 to 7.

🎨 AI illustration

#LouisianaUnmasked #NewOrleansHistory #LouisianaPurchase #FrenchQuarter #LouisianaHistory | Louisiana Unmasked
